secrets.name: The Wax Cave
secrets.text: Behind the frozen fall the wax is hollow. Somebody has lived in here a long time, warm, in the smell of it, reading by a thousand small lights.

meta.label: The Hall of Candles
meta.blurb: Candles on every shelf, every table, every ledge, all lit, and none of them ever burns down. The wax has had a long time to pile up.
